content.comment_body: Hello, I want to verify if it’s possible to directly connect two [product_name] blocks ([article_no]) using an Ethernet cable for master/slave operation. Additionally, do I need a licensed version of [product_name] software for program upload, or is it sufficient to use the demo version by connecting the master device to my laptop to upload programs and then link the units together?

Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. Regarding your first question: both units can be connected directly and operated without a designated master/slave mode—master/master configuration also works. For your second question: to upload programs to [product_name], you need the full licensed version of [product_name] software. The demo version does not support communication with real [product_name] devices.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for guidance on directly connecting two [product_name] modules via Ethernet and clarification on software licensing required for program uploads. There is uncertainty about operational modes and the limitations of the demo versus full software versions. The key issue is that the demo software does not allow direct communication with actual [product_name] hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to connect and set up two [product_name] modules for communication and upload programs using an unlicensed demo version of [product_name] software.
